values.note: City of Litchfield 2026: $30 a night for a water and electric site, $35 with sewer, plus tax; card payments carry a 3% fee (minimum $2); $5 dump fee for non-sewer sites; $25 cancellation fee, the rest kept as credit for the season.

fees.source: https://www.ci.litchfield.mn.us/2208/Lake-Ripley-Campground ('Non sewer site: $30 (plus tax) per night / Sewer site: $35 (plus tax) per night') + 2026 welcome letter ('Non-sewer sites: $30.00 per night / Sewer sites: $35.00 per night'; 'There is a $5.00 dumping fee'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.ci.litchfield.mn.us/2208/Lake-Ripley-Campground ('10 sites with electric and water hookup / 22 sites with electric, water and sewer hookup'; amperage not stated), read 2026-11-11

values.note: One row of back-in sites, #1-#32, between South Ripley Drive and the campground lane. One camper per site; vehicles park outside the campground.

sites.source: City page ('32 shore front sites Sites accommodate tents and/or campers up to 35' in length. All campers over 35' are not permitted.') + Rules ('One (1) camper per site.'; 'ALL MOTOR VEHICLES must be kept outside of campgrounds') + 2026 campground map, read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: City page ('On-site dump station / Bath house / Fish cleaning house'); campground map legend 'Restrooms/Bath House', read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026: Friday, April 17 through Sunday, October 18, weather permitting.

season.source: City page ('The campground season runs from Friday, April 17th through Sunday, October 18th, weather permitting.') + 2026 welcome letter, read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online only through the City's Rec1 site; an account is required and City staff cannot book. Booking opens in February in three tiers: 30-night stays first, then 14-night, then 3-night.

booking.source: Rules ('CAMPSITES ARE RESERVATION ONLY.'; '3 Night Minimum Reservation throughout the season'; 'CAMPSITE MAY NOT BE OCCUPIED FOR MORE THAN 30 DAYS') + welcome letter ('ALL reservations are made through a new, user-friendly website https://secure.rec1.com/MN/litchfield-mn/catalog'; 'City staff is unable to book reservations for customers.'; 'The first tier ... will require a 30-night stay per reservation. The second tier ... 14-night minimum ... The third tier ... 3-night minimum stay per reservation.'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Litchfield campground in one row along South Ripley Drive on the Lake Ripley shore. Sites back in from the campground lane, which runs between them and the water. --Claude
summary: City page, 2026 welcome letter, rules and map read: 32 sites (10 W/E $30, 22 full $35), 35-ft limit, season Apr 17-Oct 18 2026, Rec1 online only. DROP CANDIDATE: a standing 3-night minimum all season, with booking tiers that give 30-night and 14-night stays first. Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview (the campground lane runs between every site and the shore). Phone confirmed; website OK; pin OK.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (standing minimum): Rules & Regulations: '3 Night Minimum Reservation throughout the season'; city page: 'We have a 3-night minimum stay requirement when making a reservation.' Booking also favours long stays: 'The first tier will begin on February 17th at 8:00 am and will require a 30-night stay per reservation. The second tier ... will require a 14-night minimum stay per reservation. The third tier ... will require a 3-night minimum stay per reservation.' Not time-of-year and not waivable on any page.

Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview. The 2026 campground map draws sites #1-#32 as back-in spurs off a campground lane, with the lane between every site and Lake Ripley (South Ripley Drive on the other side). On imagery the camper pads (e.g. around 45.1027,-94.5308) are ~20-25 m from the water across that lane and a mown strip with scattered trees. The campground's own road between site and water rules out lakefront. The city calls them '32 shore front sites'.
Booking: an account at secure.rec1.com is required to book ('You will need an account to make a reservation'); rates are posted publicly, so this is not the login-to-see-rates rule.
Status: the page says 'Lake Ripley Campground is closed. Look forward to seeing you next year!' (end of season, not a closure).
Phone: 320-693-7201 confirmed (City Hall; the welcome letter says to call it with reservation questions). Website: https://www.ci.litchfield.mn.us/2208/Lake-Ripley-Campground works.
